newsitem.title: GREECE: SYSWARE IPO SUBSCRIBED OVER X58-COMMERCIAL BANK.
newsitem.headline: SYSWARE IPO SUBSCRIBED OVER X58-COMMERCIAL BANK.

text.p: The initial public offering of Greek Sysware System Integration SA was subscribed over 58 times based on preliminary figures, lead underwriter Commercial Bank told Reuters.

"The offering has been subscribed over 58 times according to preliminary data, but the likelihood of an even higher oversubscription rate should not be ruled out," said investment banking officer Anthony Stergiotis.

Sysware, a computer systems integrator, went public at 1,900 drachmas issuing 300,000 new common registered shares to raise 570 million drachmas. Total shares outstanding are 2.3 million after the completion of its IPO.
Sysware will be listed on the Athens bourse's small-cap parallel market. It is 70 percent owned by another parallel market listing Altec .

Commercial Bank was the lead underwriter for the IPO, with Eurobank, General Bank, Bank of Piraeus, Dorian Bank, Hellenic Securities and National Securities acting as co-underwriters. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
